adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a real issue in the diff. Looking at addGuests.handler.ts, the code at line 92 performs `prisma.booking.update()` to add attendees to the database, then later at line 155 calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` to sync with external calendars. If the calendar update fails, the database already has the new attendees committed, creating an inconsistent state. On retry, the guests would be filtered out by the `uniqueGuests` check (lines 72-76) since they already exist in `booking.attendees`, preventing the calendar from being repaired. This is a legitimate transactional consistency bug.
